However, I am confused because I also saw a note about downgrading refunds being between $5.00 and $12.00, which seems contradictory to my current need for speed. Could you please tell me how I can apply the $15.00 upgrade to my existing order right now? I am very polite and patient, but I am truly blocked from enjoying my hobby until this is sorted.
